gaps.sentence: The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: The hotel is ___ (CONVENIENT) situated near the station.
gaps.explanation: 'Conveniently situated' — the adverb modifies the participle.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
___ (APPOINT) with the results, the board replaced the management.
gaps.hint: participle adjective: how the board felt
gaps.explanation: 'Disappointed with the results' — the board experienced disappointment; '-ing' would describe the results.
